The board at http://127.0.0.1:8790 shows the lanes live. defects.what: Ruling H49 (2): before `wrangler deploy`, the dev job reads the version id serving 100 percent into a step output (empty when the Worker does not exist yet); after a red smoke it runs `wrangler rollback <that id> --yes` and prints `rolled back to <id>`, or prints `first deploy: nothing to roll back to` and exits 1. Keep the hygiene cases in step, watched failing. Then `bun run check`, `bun run build`, commit, push slice/b1b.
